B"H

# Final Implementation Plan

## Files intended for creation

- `geelooy/shared/revelation-ui/styles/index.css` — import-only entry.
- `geelooy/shared/revelation-ui/styles/tokens.css` — opt-in route tokens.
- `geelooy/shared/revelation-ui/styles/foundation.css` — scoped box sizing, media safety, typography inheritance, overflow guards.
- `geelooy/shared/revelation-ui/styles/interactions.css` — scoped hover/active/focus/disabled states.
- `geelooy/shared/revelation-ui/styles/motion.css` — scoped reveal/press/disclosure motion and reduced-motion behavior.
- `geelooy/shared/revelation-ui/styles/disclosure.css` — retractable/drawer primitives with local stacking contracts.
- `geelooy/shared/revelation-ui/js/GevurahViewportGuard.js` — detects and reports accidental horizontal overflow in development/runtime diagnostics.
- `geelooy/shared/revelation-ui/js/TiferesDisclosureController.js` — ARIA-correct disclosure coordination.
- `geelooy/shared/revelation-ui/js/YesodInteractionState.js` — coordinates pointer/keyboard interaction state without global listeners where unnecessary.
- `geelooy/shared/revelation-ui/js/MalchusSurfaceManifest.js` — opt-in composition point.

## Existing production files intended for full rewrite only after dependency reads

- Apps catalog local HTML/CSS/JS entry files.
- Social Hub HTML plus only the local CSS/JS modules whose contracts are fully traced.
- Home style/script modules only where audits reveal actual defects.
- Docs/Drive local modules only where viewport, focus, disclosure, or stacking evidence shows needed change.
- Legacy service-worker files only after registration and cache-contract archaeology.

## Implementation order

1. Confirm dirty-work boundaries and CSS/service-worker call sites.
2. Read all target CSS/JS modules and their imports/callers.
3. Create scoped primitives.
4. Migrate Apps as first proving route.
5. Static-check Apps and shared primitives.
6. Browser-check Apps at multiple viewports and interaction states.
7. Migrate Social Hub while preserving every DOM ID used by JS.
8. Verify social navigation, inbox/messages, composer, privacy, and exact-interaction flows.
9. Improve Home/Docs/Drive locally based on measured issues.
10. Continue route-family migrations through public production entry points.
11. Refactor service-worker/API code only with verified registration contracts.
12. Run full touched-file readback, syntax, style-scope, overflow, console, and interaction verification.

## Completion evidence

No completion claim without a clean changed-file inventory, explicit preservation of unrelated work, passing available checks, and browser receipts for the migrated production surfaces.
